headline: NSA network outage adds to string of US disruptions
source: Washington Post, via Drop Site and Democracy Now
pages: NSANet, the National Security Agency's classified internal network, has been down since at least early Tuesday, and some staff could not reach workplace systems. The agency staggered arrival times. The NSA said it experienced temporary degradation during scheduled routine maintenance and that mission-critical capabilities remain fully operational. US officials told CBS News there was no evidence of a cyberattack so far. Just Security reported that Rubio said there was zero evidence the recent incidents were related, though he acknowledged some may stem from a rush to patch systems ahead of AI-enabled hacking. A nationwide FAA ground stop last Friday was tied to a router.

Democracy Now also noted service outages at Apple and Google on Tuesday. The cause of the wider run of failures remains disputed.
Source: Washington Post, via Drop Site and Democracy Now
